mode: Global KOs — sum of all regions
precision: Official UI display values; KO totals and regional values are rounded. Historical snapshot, not a live feed.

boards.label: KOs
boards.rule: Adds up the best KO run in each of the four regions, on any difficulty. Higher is better.

entries.player: OF 春 夏 秋 冬

boards.label: Survival
boards.rule: Adds up the longest survival time in each region. KOs break ties. Higher time is better.

boards.label: Time attack
boards.rule: Regions won comes first, then the sum of the fastest regional wins, on any difficulty. Lower time wins within the same region count.
